forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sentDescription: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link. It expires in 1 hour.
forgotPassword.resendSuccess: We've sent a new reset link. Check your inbox.
forgotPassword.unavailable: Password reset isn't available on this instance. Contact your administrator for help.
forgotPassword.genericError: Couldn't send the reset link. Please try again.
forgotPassword.nothingChangesTitle: Nothing changes until you use the link.
forgotPassword.nothingChangesDescription: Your current password keeps working, so you can ignore the email if you remember it.

resetPassword.success: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.genericError: Couldn't reset your password. Please try again.

errors.passwordTooLong: Password must be at most {length} characters.

resetPassword.invalidDescription: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one to continue.
